title: CoreWeave signs 15-year, 133 MW lease at Galaxy's Helios campus (~$4.5B)

sources.quote: Over the 15-year term, Galaxy is contractually entitled to generate an estimated $4.5 billion of total revenue pursuant to the Lease Agreement.

The Debt Facility will fully fund the initial retrofit and expansion of Helios to deliver the first phase of power for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) operations under a long-term agreement with CoreWeave Inc.

explain: CoreWeave agreed to rent 133 megawatts at Galaxy's Helios campus in West Texas, a former bitcoin mine, for 15 years. Galaxy expects about $4.5 billion in revenue; rent began in 2026.
